findings.text: The hook now requires `atalks` on PATH (command -v atalks). A machine that still has the old install (only `atalk`) gets the hook silently disabled (one stderr line) until `npm i -g .` is rerun. NEWS says to reinstall; a fallback to `atalk` would be safer but is not required by the acceptance points.

Historical NEWS entries (e.g. wiki delete, typing bubble) had `atalk` rewritten to `atalks`, which edits past release notes. Harmless to readers and consistent with the brief's 'user-facing text', but it is a small rewrite of history.
